meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. You asked if we had to stop. We ran it. We lengthened it. It is not a bound. Sit down. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B23_dns_readable
lemmas.statement: short and longer n=32 packet DNS are a readable check past the B11c room time
lemmas.why: B13 and B22 already ran. T=0.384 > 0.375. Same box. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B23a_dns_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: a decaying packet DNS run is a closed a priori bound for classical X
lemmas.why: One IC class, finite T, finite n. X falling here does not bound X on B9b or energy-class data. Beale: a decaying packet is not ∫‖ω‖_∞.

lemmas.name: B23b_room_time_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: running past the ODE room time is continuation for classical X
lemmas.why: Continuation is an estimate, not a longer interval. Past the sitting of c=8 the path still decayed.

lemmas.name: B23c_packet_not_all_data
lemmas.statement: the working-box CONC packet class is all classical data
lemmas.why: B9b fat slow CONC is not this run. Energy-class T sits on SPREAD. One triad is not Leray.

lemmas.name: B23d_no_blow_not_bounded
lemmas.statement: didn't blow on n=32 implies X ∈ L∞
lemmas.why: Resolved decay is a reading. n=32 dealias cannot host the cascade the slogan wants. DNS-never-blew-up is refused as a close.

lemmas.name: B23e_finer_still_open
lemmas.statement: a finer box (n>32) makes the DNS run an a priori
lemmas.why: The only remaining box knob. Same leftover as B22e. Do not spawn n=64. A bigger FFT is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B23f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring DNS as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. T and n are knobs on the check. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8 into the equation.
